<thought>The 13C NMR shows only one signal in the carbonyl region (161.40 ppm), indicating a single carbonyl carbon. The IR has two nearby C=O absorptions (1704 and 1681 cm⁻¹), which can arise from the same carbonyl in different environments (e.g., conjugation, hydrogen‑bonding) rather than two distinct carbonyl groups. Therefore, the molecule contains one carbonyl group.</thought>
